label: 2021 Men's European Volleyball Championship (CEV EuroVolley) - 32nd edition
hosts: Poland, Czechia, Estonia, Finland (Krakow, Gdansk, Katowice, Ostrava, Tallinn, Tampere)
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-1 (PLAN-VB). Primary capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw), every match row citing its official CEV MatchStatistics report (unique per-row source URLs, IDs 46352-46412 pools / 46429-46444 finals; wayback-recoverable). 24 teams, 4 pools of 6: A Krakow (Tauron Arena, host Poland), B Ostrava (host Czechia), C Tampere (host Finland), D Tallinn (host Estonia); R16/QF split Gdansk (Ergo Arena) + Ostrava; SF/3P/F Katowice (Spodek); 76/76 matches, official match total 76 confirmed by infobox. FIDELITY: per-team pool points recomputed from set tokens == wikitext standings spw/spl for ALL 24 teams (incl. UKR exactly 446-446). Spine R16->F exact. Champions Italy (7th title, MVP Giannelli) d. Slovenia 3-2 (11-15 fifth from SLO side); bronze Poland d. Serbia 3-0. EXTREME-SET SHOWCASE byte-preserved: Slovenia d. Poland SF with a 37-35 fourth set (32-30 second also lost by POL); Czechia d. France R16 34-32 third; Croatia d. Latvia 31-29 fourth + Slovakia d. Croatia lost 29-31 fourth; Serbia d. Greece 15-5 fifth after losing a 30-28 fourth. Sep 1-19 2021.
